title: ml.churn_features
description: Daily feature snapshot per customer for the churn model. No personal data.

snapshot_date.description: Date the features were computed for.

orders_90d.description: Number of orders in the 90 days before the snapshot.

avg_amount_90d.description: Mean order amount over the same window; null with no orders.

days_since_last_order.description: Days from the last order to the snapshot; null with no orders.

segment.description: Commercial segment at the snapshot date.
